change: Return to the effective-round-2 AVAILABLE capability policy and remove false-positive source-audit repairs by accepting AsyncStorage multiGet/multiSet plus semantically equivalent forecast and prior-week comparison labels.

realInitialErrors: src/lib/domain.ts referenced an undefined goalId variable.
Requested JSON export did not invoke expo-sharing.

strengths: Namespaced AsyncStorage hydrates before saving and persists every state mutation; storage is seeded only when empty.
Forecast requires three real sample dates, weekly amounts are compared per goal/unit, backfills use real dates, and the seed visibly exercises amber rest plus red rollover states.

All four destinations, create/edit/delete/check-in, historical weekly notes/report, inline SVG charts/icons, confirmed destructive actions, import/export capabilities, and animated confetti are present.
Typecheck, source audit, export, artifact binding, exact desktop launch, and both trace-scope audits pass.
gaps: Goals that are both yesterday-missed and overdue are rendered twice in the priority region, while priority goals are excluded from the full editable Today cards.
The streak scan begins at the earliest recorded entry, so multiple misses between goal creation and the first entry can be ignored.
The system-share path uses an unproven data URI and full import validation occurs after confirmation rather than before the overwrite dialog; version migration is only implicit defaulting.
Seed has 13 records, so the >=20 backup banner is initially unreachable.

Harmony Go rendered LinearGradient primary buttons with transparent backgrounds and white low-contrast labels; the desktop launch state is a stretched single priority column rather than a useful two-column dashboard.
Core mutation/restart persistence was intentionally not executed in this loop, so runtime persistence remains unproven for this artifact.

decision: Valid but rejected for speed: generation is 50.2% slower than effective round 2 and 23.0% slower than the baseline. The semantic gate change is retained because it eliminated false-positive diagnostics; effective round 2 remains the speed winner.
